segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the pads are hydrating rather than stripping, helping with flaking and dead skin buildup without disrupting the skin barrier, including one using tretinoin who found it gentle enough to use alongside it.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one describing a partner's acne-prone oily skin, report visibly reduced dead skin cell buildup and more refined-looking texture, though one notes the pad itself leaves a slightly greasy after-feel.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination-dehydrated skin are mostly positive, reporting smoother texture and fewer dead skin cells without new blemishes, though they note limited effect on existing blackheads, pore size, or blemish marks; one reviewer with combination-dehydrated skin, however, found it left her skin drier and more flaky and switched to a different product.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as having sensitive skin are mostly positive, reporting no irritation or only mild, short-lived stinging when used a few times a week; several other reviewers who don't identify as sensitive themselves still warn that sensitive skin may find it tingling or harsh, especially with daily use.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who states her age, 48, reports an initial sting and a small breakout on day one, followed by glowier, clearer-looking skin after two weeks of use.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe the pads as hydrating and say they don't feel stripped afterward, but a substantial number report the opposite: pads that felt barely saturated with essence, skin that felt drier with more visible flaking during use, or a need to follow up with extra moisturizer because the pads alone aren't hydrating enough.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the pads reduced redness and inflammation around blemishes and after breakouts calmed down; one reviewer, however, warns that leaving a pad on too long can leave the skin red, describing it as feeling like it strips the skin barrier.
concerns.barrier: Reactions are mixed: many reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, report no irritation or only brief stinging that fades with continued use, while others experience burning, small bumps, tightness, or breakouts, especially with daily use or if a pad is left on too long.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin, with many describing faster healing of active breakouts, reduced blackheads, and calmer hormonal acne within days to a few weeks; several others, however, say they saw no real improvement in blackheads, whiteheads, or blemish marks despite regular use.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily or combination skin say it helps control excess oil, but a number of others report the pads themselves leave a slightly greasy or sticky after-feel on the skin.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report visible fading of dark spots and hyperpigmentation after a few weeks of use, including one who combined it with a separate dark spot corrector and one who used it on darker patches on the underarms.

aspects.libelle: Pads often don't adhere well, slide off face
Fairly pricey, best bought on sale

extraits.titre: I felt it did a decent job of...
extraits.texte: I felt it did a decent job of managing dead skin cells! From the first use, I noticed my skin became a bit smoother, and I felt like my skin texture improved somewhat. I also liked that the pads were quite large and square, so one pad was enough to cover almost my entire face. I didn't really feel much hydration, and it gave me a slightly burning sensation! I absolutely wouldn't recommend this for those with super sensitive skin. Since it's an exfoliating pad, it might be expected, but it felt like something was breaking out on my skin, so it wasn't a product I reached for often. The scent also had a slightly harsh feel, so I wouldn't recommend it for those sensitive to fragrances either.

extraits.titre: As someone with dry skin, I...
extraits.texte: As someone with dry skin, I tend to get a lot of dead skin cells in winter, but using these pads has definitely improved my skin's condition. When I used the textured side on areas with small bumps, I noticed significant improvement there too. The pads are soaked in essence, making them incredibly hydrating. Although they're exfoliating pads, I appreciated that they weren't overly harsh. They're perfect for gentle daily dead skin cell care. What I loved most was the square shape of the pads. Compared to round ones, these made it easier to exfoliate tricky areas like around the nose and eyes. Another plus is that you can stack these with other toner pads from the same line, which I found really convenient. The lid seems a bit flimsy. I accidentally dropped it while it was open, and it cracked at the seam. I wish the connection was sturdier. Also, for some reason, the pads tend to fall off the face during masking. I hope this could be improved. Sensitive skin types might find these a bit irritating, especially when exfoliating. It's great to put these on while blow­drying your hair ­ it helps prevent your skin from getting too dry.

extraits.titre: As someone with oily skin, I...
extraits.texte: As someone with oily skin, I noticed a visible reduction in dead skin cells after using this. My skin texture feels more refined and balanced. The only downside is that it leaves a slightly greasy feeling after application, which is a bit disappointing. I've found the perfect timing ­ I apply the smooth part to my cheeks and forehead, and by the time I'm done drying my hair, it's just right.

extraits.titre: It was better than I expected.
extraits.texte: It was better than I expected. I've used over 5 bottles of this product over a long period. I don't think this product suits me. When I was using it, my skin felt dry and my dead skin cells became more noticeable. These issues disappeared after I switched to a different product. If you have combination dehydrated skin like me and plan to use this, make sure to supplement with other hydrating products to maintain moisture balance.

extraits.titre: I'm 48 who doesn't use fancy products
extraits.texte: I'm 48 who doesn't buy fancy products and I love this stuff. My skin looks dewy after a couple of weeks of using this. My initial complaint was my makeup doesn't go on well and the makeup artist said this product will even out my skin texture. It did sting the first day and I did have a same breakout above my lip. After 2 weeks I noticed my skin is glowy and my skin looks clear. Makeup is going on well too.

I started getting dark spots on my face, which is not a good look, so I found these guys, and after using them for 3 weeks, my dark spots are seriously almost gone. I use a dark spot corrector along with it and I couldn't be happier. My skin looks absolutely radiant again.

This product gently exfoliates dead skin cells without irritation. After use, my skin feels smoother, and subsequent skincare products seem to absorb better, making it great for consistent use. The pads are pleasantly thick and well­soaked in essence, keeping the skin hydrated during application. Although it's an exfoliating product, it leaves the skin feeling fresh without dryness, making it suitable even for super sensitive skin. While the pads are soft, they contain exfoliating ingredients that might be too harsh for daily use on sensitive skin. If you're new to the product or have particularly sensitive skin, I'd recommend using it every 2­3 days. Also, although the scent is subtle, it might be slightly off­putting for those who prefer fragrance­free products. Using this before makeup helps smooth out the skin, creating a perfect canvas for better foundation application!
